name: SEC EDGAR
robots_policy: Use SEC APIs and EDGAR fair-access policy with declared User-Agent and <=10 requests/sec.
content_license_note: US government filings are public; preserve accession URL and filing metadata.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is SEC acceptance time or first crawler observation if acceptance is missing
coverage_scope: US public company filings and exhibits
notes: Primary PIT source for US public-company disclosures.

name: SEC Companyfacts API
robots_policy: Use SEC API access patterns with descriptive User-Agent and local cache.
content_license_note: Public government API; cache full JSON responses for reproducibility.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is API retrieval time unless filing acceptance timestamp is linked
coverage_scope: Structured XBRL facts for US public companies
notes: Best source for fundamentals and chart extraction when linked back to filings.

name: Federal Reserve Board
robots_policy: Prefer official DDP downloads and RSS pages where available.
content_license_note: Public central-bank releases; preserve release timestamp and vintage where available.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is release timestamp or first crawler observation
coverage_scope: Federal Reserve statistical releases and policy data

name: FRED API
robots_policy: Use FRED API and cache observations plus realtime_start/realtime_end vintages.
content_license_note: Public macro series; document vintage and retrieval date.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is FRED realtime_start or retrieval date when no vintage is used
coverage_scope: US macro and financial time series backbone
notes: Use for yield curve rates spreads inflation and macro indicators.

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
robots_policy: Use public BLS API and release calendar; avoid scraping dynamic pages.
content_license_note: Public labor and inflation releases; preserve release schedule timestamp.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is official release time or API retrieval time for historical backfill
coverage_scope: Labor inflation wages employment and prices
notes: Use for CPI payrolls unemployment wages and PPI.

name: Bureau of Economic Analysis
robots_policy: Use BEA API with registered key and metadata endpoints.
content_license_note: Public national accounts data; preserve release timestamp and revision vintage.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is official release time or API retrieval time for historical backfill
coverage_scope: National accounts GDP PCE income profits and trade
notes: Use for economic activity and corporate profits context.

name: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data
robots_policy: Prefer Fiscal Data API and official CSV downloads.
content_license_note: Public Treasury data; preserve dataset date and endpoint metadata.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is dataset date plus retrieval timestamp
coverage_scope: Debt interest rates fiscal and Treasury datasets
notes: Use for fiscal debt and Treasury context.

name: New York Fed Markets Data
robots_policy: Use published Markets Data APIs and cache responses.
content_license_note: Public central-bank market operations data; preserve operation date and retrieval date.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is operation date or retrieval timestamp for historical backfill
coverage_scope: Market operations rates and liquidity facilities
notes: Use for funding and market plumbing evidence.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
robots_policy: Use EIA API v2 and official downloads; cache series metadata.
content_license_note: Public energy data; preserve series date and retrieval timestamp.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is series release date or retrieval timestamp
coverage_scope: Energy prices inventories production and demand
notes: Use for oil energy and sector stress context.

name: Census Bureau
robots_policy: Use Census APIs or official downloadable tables.
content_license_note: Public housing retail trade manufacturing and demographic data.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is release date or retrieval timestamp
coverage_scope: Housing retail manufacturing trade and demographics
notes: Use for cyclicals housing and demand context.

name: Company Investor Relations
robots_policy: Use official company pages feeds and sitemaps only; check robots per issuer.
content_license_note: Issuer material; keep URL publish time revision hash and original page snapshot.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is first crawler observation unless page exposes reliable publish timestamp
coverage_scope: Official issuer IR releases presentations reports and archives
notes: Useful but promotion risk is higher than SEC filings.

name: User Favorite Website
robots_policy: User URLs require health checks and source labels before corpus use.
content_license_note: License varies by site; never assume redistribution rights.
point_in_time_policy: available_at is first crawler observation only
notes: Favorite status changes display priority but not credibility.
